SddRoot.keywords: root, portal, vision, scope-graph, idempotent, project-setup, infra-bootstrap
SddRoot.Mission:
Owner of `specs/README.md` — the Project Portal: Vision + Scope Graph + Scopes table. Idempotent: runs any number of times to refine vision, extend the graph, or bootstrap the first infra-base spec. Loaded lazily by the router; the router-core beliefs it relies on are declared in `BeliefState deps` (inherited, not repeated).
Input — operator intent at project level. Output: - `specs/README.md` with Vision + Scope Graph + Scopes table. - Optional minimal `specs/infra-base/infra-base.spec.md` when the operator declared tooling.
When the portal is absent, root reads the probe facts already in the `sdd-state` snapshot: a greenfield repo (no code) is initialized here; a repo that already holds code is handed to the from-code recovery branch (`discover-from-code`) — root never invents a vision over code that already exists.
Out of scope: design of any individual scope (its vision, architecture, requirements, modules) — that is the scope branch. Root writes only the project-level map.

BeliefState.deps: AX_OPERATOR_LANGUAGE, AX_TOOL_INVOCATION, AX_OPERATOR_DIALOGUE_STYLE, AX_DIALOGUE_DISCIPLINE, AX_OPERATOR_SAFEGUARD, AX_NO_PROCESS_NARRATION, AX_STATELESS_ARTIFACT
BeliefState.Axiom:
The `root` flow is the primary owner of `specs/README.md`. Other flows MUST NOT rewrite this file. Reads are unrestricted.
Explicit, narrow exceptions (append-only edits permitted, no rewrites): - The `scope` flow creating a brand-new scope MAY append a placeholder row to the Scopes table tagged `🚧 (awaiting root sync)` so the new scope is visible in the Portal before the next `root` run. - The `module` flow MUST NOT touch this file; its Portal-level summaries are appended only to its scope spec.
Any other edit by another flow → audit finding `STALE_AFTER_PIVOT` or `EXECUTION_LOG_INCOMPLETE` depending on context. The next `root` run reconciles placeholders into full rows.

`setup` has no hard modes (no greenfield / extension / pivot). - Portal absent → create from scratch. - Portal present → read and propose updates derived from intake; operator dictates what to change.
No silent assumptions: empty intake against an existing Portal → HALT `H_NO_INTENT` («what are we changing today?»).

Scope Graph is a directed dependency graph. Rules: - Edge A→B means «scope A depends-on scope B»: A inherits B's effective rules in the cascade and may consume B's contracts. - Cycle in the graph → `H_CYCLE_IN_GRAPH` (abort). - scope-type constraints: `infrastructure` and `interface` scopes are typically leaves (depend only on other infra / interface). `product` and `library` scopes depend on infra + interface. - The graph is rendered as a Mermaid `graph TD` block inside the Portal.

If the operator declares basic tooling (package manager, type-checker, linter) in intake, the `root` flow materializes a minimal `specs/infra-base/infra-base.spec.md` with scope-type=infrastructure: Vision (one sentence) + Tool Stack (table with tool names only, no Decision Log yet). The full Decision Log appears when the operator runs the `infra` flow on infra-base.
The minimal bootstrap intentionally bypasses the full `infra` flow — it only locks the tool choice without the Design Variants ritual.

Scopes table in the Portal: each row = link to the scope spec + scope-type + status emoji + one-line description. - ✅ — spec exists and is approved. - 🚧 — spec being authored / `discovery` not yet run. - Status is derived purely from the presence of `specs//.spec.md`.
The `## Vision` section in the Portal is present only when the project contains at least one product or library scope. For tooling-only repos (sandboxes, infra repos) the Vision section is omitted.

A mutation is not done until its scope passes the mechanical check. Any flow that creates or evolves an artifact under a scope — spec, module, ticket, DAG, tracker — closes by running `sdd-check` on the affected scope (`sdd-check --all specs/`; portal, task-DAG, tracker, or cross-scope work → `sdd-check --all .`) and resolving or consciously deferring every finding before handing off.

ChatProtocol.Contract:
Questions must LOOK like questions and stay readable on any theme. A `### ❓ Вопросы — реши ` section header; each question numbered `Q`; options described in words. Never use `+` / `-` signs for pros / cons (they render black and vanish on dark themes). Group obvious sub-questions into one; do not pad the count.
Low-stakes — a recommendation is allowed, but only as the result of `AX_DIVERGE_BEFORE_RECOMMEND` (not the first typical answer):
### ❓ Вопросы — реши «годится» = беру все рекомендации, или поправь по номерам.
**Q1 · <вопрос?>** ✅ **<рекомендованный вариант>** `[code]` — почему подходит именно под эту задачу. Иначе: - **<альтернатива>** `[code]` — _за: <плюс> · против: <минус>_
High-stakes / architecture — do NOT pre-anchor one pick. List the strongest candidates (include a non-obvious / tail one) with «за / против» and let the operator choose; or give a recommendation only alongside its strongest alternative and the reason it might win.
A plain binary question needs no list — recommendation + inline alternative:
**Q2 · <вопрос?>** ✅ **<рекомендация>** — почему. _или <короткая альтернатива>?_

SddRoot.HaltConditions: | 🛑 ID | Trigger | |---|---| | `H_NO_INTENT` | Operator invoked the root flow with empty intake against an existing Portal | | `H_CYCLE_IN_GRAPH` | Scope Graph contains a cycle (detected by `sdd-check`) | | `H_SCOPE_VS_MODULE_AMBIGUITY` | Operator labels as «scope» something that resembles a module | | `H_OPERATOR_REJECT` | Operator rejected Vision, Scope Graph, or the final Portal |

Step.Goal: Determine today's change set from state.
Step.Action: State from the router (`sdd-state`) already reports whether `specs/README.md` exists. - Absent → no portal yet: read `CODE` from the `sdd-state` output already in context — the probe (`CODE`/`INFRA`, code-dirs, configs) is part of the default snapshot; do NOT call `sdd-state` a second time for it. - `CODE=absent` (empty / only package.json) → **greenfield init**. The operator already saw the `sdd-state` card, shown verbatim as its own fenced unit by the router's SHOW-gate, and, for empty intake, confirmed «Создать проект» at the router's entry Ask (`AX_DIALOGUE_DISCIPLINE`) — the interview opens HERE, never before that card and never as prose dumped into the reply. An interview question that precedes the card, or that re-summarizes it instead of the router having shown it, violates the same gate the router enforces (`H_ASK_WITHOUT_CARD`) — a summary of the card is not the card. Ask through the SAME channel: the `AskUserQuestion` tool when available (open answer via its free-text slot), otherwise `QUESTION_FORMAT` (Russian) — one structured question: «Как называется проект? Опиши в одном предложении его vision и первые scope'ы (infra-base, backend, web — на черновую).» - `CODE=present` → **from-code recovery** — do NOT invent a vision over existing code: `READ_AND_USE_DIRECTIVE("ai/directives/sdd-v2/discover-from-code.directive.xml")`. - Present → empty intake → `H_NO_INTENT`; otherwise classify the change: vision / add scope / update graph / infra bootstrap. Root has no hard modes — create when absent, propose intake-derived updates when present, per `AX_IDEMPOTENT_MODES`.
No product / library scope → skip Vision (`AX_VISION_ONLY_FOR_APPLICATION`). Else propose a one-sentence Vision: what we build and which problem it solves. Approval Check. STOP.

Step.Goal: Place each scope by its relationships first, then its edges.
Step.Action: For each scope the relationship question comes FIRST (`AX_OPERATOR_SAFEGUARD`): who will depend on it, what it depends on, and whether it is cross-cutting (used by ≥2 scopes). Probe narrow framing — «авторизация только для web? а API / будущие клиенты?». The answer drives three things: the «scope vs module» test (a thing used inside one scope may be a module, not a scope → `H_SCOPE_VS_MODULE_AMBIGUITY`); the `depends-on` edges; and, when it is cross-cutting, a note that cross-scope scenarios or an interface scope may be needed. If the change REMOVES or RENAMES a scope, first surface what it orphans — its `specs//…` spec, tasks, and inbound references — and resolve with the operator (move / delete / repoint); never silently leave orphans. Then propose scope-type with rationale and render the Mermaid `graph TD` — edge semantics (A→B = A depends-on B), acyclicity, and scope-type constraints per `AX_SCOPE_GRAPH_DISCIPLINE` (a cycle → `H_CYCLE_IN_GRAPH`). Approval Check. STOP.

Step.Goal: Materialize the minimal infra-base spec if tooling was declared.
Step.Action: No tooling declared → skip. Else, per `AX_INFRA_BASE_BOOTSTRAP`, `READ_AND_USE_DIRECTIVE("ai/directives/sdd-v2/formats/infra-base-minimal-spec.xml")` and write `specs/infra-base/infra-base.spec.md` to that format (scope-type infrastructure, one-sentence Vision, Tool Stack table, note pointing to `discovery infra-base` for the full Decision Log — the bootstrap only locks the tool choice, the full `infra` flow comes later). Approval Check. STOP.

When `specs/README.md` does not exist yet, create its skeleton via `sdd-new portal` first — it never overwrites and prints the section manifest (which sections are REQUIRED and what to fill); when it already exists, edit it in place, skip `sdd-new`. Content guidance per `READ_AND_USE_DIRECTIVE("ai/directives/sdd-v2/formats/portal-structure.xml")` and assemble the Portal to that format. Scope status (✅ / 🚧) comes from `sdd-state` (presence of `specs//.spec.md`), not a manual stat — rows per `AX_SCOPE_TABLE_FORMAT`. Reconcile any placeholder rows left by the scope flow into full rows — root is the primary owner of `specs/README.md` and the only flow that rewrites it (`AX_PORTAL_PRIMARY_OWNER`). Write the file. Then run `sdd-check --all .` to verify portal integrity — graph acyclicity, graph↔table↔spec coherence, no orphan specs or dangling scope references — and resolve any finding before finishing, per `AX_CLOSE_WITH_INTEGRITY_CHECK`. Approval Check. STOP.

SddRoot.ChatOutput:
Service line — dim, internal, never narrated (per `AX_NO_PROCESS_NARRATION`): `🗺️ ROOT_R · · · conf=`. Breadcrumb milestones for this flow (per `BREADCRUMB_FORMAT`): Vision · Scope Graph · Infra · Portal.
A step-boundary / decision message (the decision card) is sectioned with markdown headers, in this order. Skip any section empty for this step. During free dialogue inside a step the agent does NOT print this layout — it just talks.
`` — internal anchor + scope + mode + confidence (supplied by the branch) `` — per `BREADCRUMB_FORMAT`
## `` `` — одной фразой, что делаем
### 🤔 Как я понял задачу — per `UNDERSTANDING_BLOCK_FORMAT` (goes at the TOP) ### главное решение — the crux in plain words; add a diagram per `FLOW_DIAGRAM_WHEN` if it is a flow ### ❓ Вопросы — реши N — per `QUESTION_FORMAT` ### ↓ Детали — по желанию — reasoning, full comparison, change-list (per `AX_PROGRESSIVE_DISCLOSURE`)
One line under the service line: this session's milestones, each with a status marker — `✅` done · `▶️` now · `░` not yet. Delta only; never re-list everything already settled. This is the «where are we», and it replaces a verbose run-on of finished steps.
`<Веха>` ✅ · `<Веха>` ✅ · `<Веха>` ▶️ · `<Веха>` ░ · `<Веха>` ░
The agent's compressed read of the task — its own confirmation of blind spots so the operator can catch a misread. A `### 🤔 Как я понял задачу` section near the TOP, then an italic blockquote, explicitly optional, 2–3 sentences: the essence + the single riskiest assumption, with the assumption linked to the question it maps to. Never a restate of settled content.
### 🤔 Как я понял задачу > _Можно не читать, если доверяешь._ > квинтэссенция — что считаю главным. > **Где могу ошибаться:** самое хрупкое допущение — это вопрос Q``.
A sub-topic dive inside a step collapses to two lines, not a five-field Return Summary:
→ ушли в `<тема>` ← `<итог одной фразой>`
When a decision is about a flow — data moving, state transitions, start / stop conditions — draw a tiny ASCII diagram; one glance beats a paragraph. This is the one place a fenced block is allowed inside an operator message (alignment matters). Keep it small.
``` [сеть] [auth] [конфиг] ──всё есть──► ОПРОС идёт ▲ │ └──── снова есть ──── ПАУЗА ◄───────┘ что-то пропало ```
Decision first, reasoning on demand. The must-read top of a message is short: where we are + my read + what to decide. Everything heavy — full option comparison, evidence, the change-list, derivations — goes BELOW a `### ↓ Детали — по желанию` header. Never dump reasoning above the questions. Facts already verified collapse to one line («сверился: …»); uncertainties that need the operator BECOME the questions — never list them twice.
